papers.citation: Katsura et al. (2004), Mg2SiO4 ringwoodite
papers.reason: All 127 official Table 2 observations were transcribed, but the published BM3-MGD coefficients miss them by 1.890 GPa RMSE when the chemically required n=7 atoms per formula unit is used. The hidden normalization, Debye-temperature law, and energy/volume convention remain unresolved, so no production EOS was added.
